description: This file defines a server-side route handler for generating Open Graph images dynamically based on URL parameters. It uses React JSX to compose the image content and fetches custom fonts from Google Fonts.

methods.name: loadGoogleFont
methods.description: Fetches and loads the 'Instrument Serif' font from Google Fonts as an ArrayBuffer.

methods.name: loadJetbrainsMonoGoogleFont
methods.description: Fetches and loads the 'JetBrains Mono' font from Google Fonts as an ArrayBuffer.
